source.title: Thermodynamic Uncertainty Relation with Quantum Feedback

model_scope.system: finite-dimensional open quantum system weakly coupled to a thermal environment
model_scope.dynamics: monitored quantum jumps; instantaneous Markovian feedback; GKSL no-feedback baseline
model_scope.evidence_status: LITERATURE_ONLY; no UQPU implementation or measurement
